verdict.rationale: Framer provides multiple write-capable surfaces for agents: an External Agent connection (no separate MCP needed) that lets Claude Code/Cursor/Codex read and write canvas, components, and CMS collections (create/update/delete), a Server API for programmatic site automation, and an Editor Plugin SDK that can insert/modify layers, images, and components. Changes from external agents are isolated to branches for safe review/merge, and Framer's own AI agent can create/modify pages, copy, typography, and layout directly. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the external-agent write API and Server API beyond first-party docs, and a published OpenAPI/schema reference (probe found no openapi.json).
